**Observation Log:**

[FACT] The user is trying to get a gift for a coworker who is leaving soon.  
[FACT] The user has been doing a lot of shopping lately and has spent around $500 in the past month on gifts for others.

[PREFERENCE] The user prefers a heartfelt message expressing love and appreciation for their sister in the birthday card.
